machine.note: machine shared with other jobs while measured

protocol.frames: 12 frames at the middle of equal segments, max 640 px wide, JPEG q 3 (sampleAndEmbedFrames of datum/locate.ts, replicated); CLIPImageProcessor preprocessing (shortest side 224 bicubic, centre crop 224, CLIP mean/std)
protocol.split: manifest videos sorted by id; even index = train (every choice), odd index = test (report only)
protocol.existing: decideLocation with DEFAULT_LOCATE_PARAMS of the current engine, from the SigLIP vectors cached by datum:evaluate; open = whole gallery, unknown = own Wikidata item left out; GPS in the file not used
protocol.aggregations: sum = summed per-frame logits (identical to summed per-frame log-probabilities); mean = mean logit; embedding = renormalised mean embedding; mixture = mean of per-frame probabilities
protocol.answers: top1 = best gallery point; modePeak / modeCentre = best point / weighted centre of the mode (gallery points within 25 km) with the most mass; refined = best point of a 0.05° then 0.01° local grid around the 3 best modes scored with the location encoder
protocol.countryAcc: top country of the method's distribution (GeoCLIP: gallery mass per country; existing: its country posterior; fusion: as the recipe sets it); answerCountryAcc: country the answer point lies in
protocol.objective: mean of the five accuracies (1, 25, 200, 750, 2500 km); for fusion averaged over open and unknown, train half only
